lines.en: The interviewer asked me why I wanted to work for their company.
I was so nervous before the interview that I could not eat anything in the morning.
You should arrive at least fifteen minutes early, so you have time to relax.
She has worked in marketing for five years, which makes her a strong candidate.
If I get the job, I will have to move closer to the office.
They told me they would call me by the end of the week, but I am still waiting.
He was asked to describe a difficult situation he had dealt with at work.
Dressing well for an interview shows that you take the opportunity seriously.
I prepared for the interview by reading about the company and practicing my answers.
Whether they choose me or not, I am glad I had the experience.
